Stock of the week

Two Reads, One Name

16 août 20265.5/10

My desk and my screeners disagree almost every day, and that is by design. The desk is me, reading charts and flow, choosing names I would put my own money in. The pullback signal is code that ignores me completely. It looks for stocks that ran, then gave part of the move back, and it flags them at the point where that giving back usually stops. Thursday the desk took NGNE. Friday the pullback signal returned the same ticker at 35.63 with a score of 100, the top of its scale. Two readings that never speak to each other landed on the same name inside a day of each other, and that is rare enough that I stop and look when it happens.

Here is the thesis, and it fits in three lines. NGNE ran, then pulled back. Two independent methods read that pullback as finished rather than as the front edge of a longer slide. The trade is the bounce, and nothing more than the bounce.

I want to be honest about what that agreement buys you. It removes the worst failure mode of a discretionary pick, which is me falling for a chart I already wanted to like. On the other side, a screener will hand you a perfect setup on a name no serious person would own, and my eyes catch that before the code does. What the overlap does not do is tell you the move is coming. I have no published record of what this convergence is worth over time, and I am not going to dress it up as an edge before I do.

The levels are simple. The entry is around 35.63, the price where the signal fired, because that is the level both reads were built on. Much above it and you are chasing a bounce that already happened. The invalidation sits under the low of the pullback, and that low is the whole argument. If the buyers who are supposed to be there let it go, the setup was a picture and the trade is over.

What kills this is the stock continuing to retrace instead of turning. A close under the pullback low ends it, and I would read that as two methods agreeing on something that was never there. Watch how price behaves around 35.63 and around that low over the next few sessions. This one gets decided fast.

À surveiller 35.63 et le point bas du pullback : une clôture sous ce point bas met fin à la thèse.
